datasets.title: Gas and mass of the Bullet
datasets.description: The 2006 composite of the Bullet Cluster in its layers: Chandra's X-ray image of the hot gas in pink and the mass map from gravitational lensing in blue. Each is drawn as a body round about the line of the collision: a symmetry the papers assume, not a measured depth. The visible-light image, with its stars and galaxies removed, stands flat at the cluster's distance.
datasets.summary: Pink is X-ray gas and blue is the lensing mass map, each drawn round the line of the collision. Their depth is not measured.

facts.label: Colors
facts.value: Pink: hot gas in X-rays (Chandra). Blue: mass from gravitational lensing. Orange and white: galaxies in visible light (Magellan, Hubble)
